I am constantly seeking opportunities to expand my skill set and push the boundaries of motion design. I believe that effective communication and collaboration are essential in delivering exceptional results, and I am always open to feedback and constructive criticism to refine my work.

I am excited about the opportunity to contribute my expertise and creativity to new projects and to work with a dynamic team of professionals. If you are looking for a talented Motion Designer who is dedicated to delivering visually stunning and engaging motion graphics, I would love to discuss how I can contribute to your organization.

More info: I am a 2D artist with a passion for creating immersive visual experiences. My expertise lies in creating concept art, character designs, and environment art for games. I have worked with a variety of studios and projects, including Lithuanian studio on "Spellfire," a game based on cryptocurrency. I was then approached by "Metacontinental" to work on their own cryptocurrency-based project. Prior to this, I worked with "YarlWorld" on their physical card game "Visichi" where I served as the lead artist.

At Lithuanian studio, I was responsible for creating concept art and environment art for "Spellfire." I gained valuable experience working on a cryptocurrency-based project and honed my skills in creating dynamic and engaging art assets. My work caught the attention of "Metacontinental," who reached out to me to join their team.

At "YarlWorld," I worked as the lead artist on their physical card game "Visichi." I was responsible for designing characters, creating card art, and overseeing the overall visual style of the game. This experience allowed me to develop a keen eye for detail and the ability to effectively communicate with team members to achieve a cohesive visual style.

Overall, my experience working with different studios and projects has allowed me to gain a diverse skill set and a unique perspective on game development. I am excited to continue exploring the creative potential of 2D art in new and innovative ways.

788b5e9b-f0fe-5692-8ad5-b5304e171729.text:
2D Artist | ID: 788b5e9b-f0fe-5692-8ad5-b5304e171729
Primary Keyword: Artist
English Level: intermediate
Experience Years: 6.0
More info: My career as a 2D artist started at university, where I met a lot of people with the
same interests as mine. In my graduation time, I had the opportunity to work as a
concept artist in game projects, developing scenes, key arts and characters.
After graduation I still felt that I was not ready to apply to work for a game studio, so I
started to search for courses, workshops and events that could help me in that long
journey. In that period of my life I found Skilltree and their courses helped me a lot to
improve as an artist. I also went to Topia Art Experience, where I could talk and have
some portfolio reviews with Renowned artists from the Game Industry, like Ursula
Dorada from Blizzard. It was a great opportunity to exchange experiences and
knowledge with other artists, which made me sure that what I wanted was to really
be an artist in the game industry.
From August of 2018 to June 2021 I worked as an Illustrator at Gocase Brazil, where
I experienced a lot of different Art Styles to a huge list of products, a great number of
them became Best sellers illustrated products. I also learned a lot about team
management and art direction.
Currently, I'm working as Lead 2D Artist at Gameplan Studio, creating illustrations,
art guides, and concept arts for some IPs in production

Looking For: I'm looking for interesting projects with high graphics requirements to improve my level. I really want to try something new. Therefore, I DO NOT consider proposals for match-3 and casino projects.
Primary Keyword: Artist
English Level: intermediate
Experience Years: 8.0
More info: Hi! My name is Lena.

Currently I work in two main directions - the developing and content maintaining for mobile games, and creating comics.
I have been working in gamedev for 8 years. During this time, I’ve worked on games of different genres: Match-3, Digger, Beat-Em-Up. I’ve engaged in development new projects (sketches, concepts, prototyping) and creation of content to support games (drawing characters, mechanics, locations). I especially love in drawing the concepts of characters and monsters.

Also I develop game user interfaces (UI), its structure and design. My tasks were to develop a clear interface and create a compact constructor for it.

Besides doing hand-ons work on the project, some part of my daily activities include reviewing art and effects, compliance with the given style and development of color schemes. As well as coordination with animation and techart teams.

Additionally, I’m developing my own project. I create the comic and make all the stages of development in it - from idea and storyboards to design of text bubbles. I adore to make highly detailed illustrations with complex compositional solutions. I would be interested in doing storytelling and graphic novels on a commercial basis.

At a basic level, I work in 3D editor and practice creating photorealistic concepts for games and movies.
Highlights: Last year I launched the Patreon for my own project “The Holy City” and I’m continuing to support it. This is a fantasy comic-ongoing.

I have 9 years of experience in the video game industry in a position of CG Illustrator. If you need CG illustration in a style like semi-realism (I can draw in cartoonish and casual, but not as often), you are welcome. I can do a test art if you do not have enough examples in my portfolio.

During my career, I have done a lot of tasks in raster graphics and the design of characters and environments. So you can entrust me with a job of any complexity. From my side, I will provide you with high-quality results within a deadline.

Hard skills (2d Illustration):
- Concept art in genres like as fantasy, steampunk, sci-fi (characters, environment, ships, technics, items)
- Semi-realistic, cartoonish, watercolor styles
- Pixel perfect casual digital drawing
- Understanding anatomy, the base of a light, coloristic, and composition.

Soft skills:
- 3d modelling (pro level)
- PBR texturing
- applications Zbrush, 3dsMax, Substance Painter/Designer
I don't NSFW art. I can't create animations as a professional. And please do not propose a position of Technical artist.

bea56df2-775c-5d24-8fbf-31daeea93775.text:
2D Concept Artist | ID: bea56df2-775c-5d24-8fbf-31daeea93775
Looking For: I would like to join a creative team to work on a long-term project. I am ready to do my best at concept design and refining 2D art. I am ready to offer my creative ideas and my profesional vision. I appreciate trust and honesty between team members, so I want it to be a productive creative collaboration.
Primary Keyword: Artist
English Level: fluent
Experience Years: 5.0
More info: I'm a Concept Artist with over 4 years experience in creating art for computer and mobile games. My expertise includes working with different art styles and pipelines. I'm truly a big fan of my job, so I put a great effort to my professional growth.
Currently I have strong skills at designing characters and character skins in most styles. My favourite part is filling it with life and personality using design and artistic principals. 
Also I have a strong experience in designing environment props and assets. 

In my work I mostly use Photoshop software. But also I like using ZBrush for sculpting some assets to use it for both concepting and overpainting. Also I have an experience at texturing stylized character in Substance Painter. I have quite flexible mind, so I easily meet any style requirements, pipeline specifics and new software.

My biggest, I would say, brightest achievement is to become a leader of art team as my first work experience. It was a small start-up team which I joined as a 2D/Concept artist. Few months later founders found me so responsible and engaged into the project so much, so they asked me to lead a small art team, to help translating their vision to artists to bring the project to it's cohesive view. That project was mostly about characters, plenty of skins for every character, challenging 2D animation. But also I cared a lot about backgrounds and some artistic UI elements. 
This experience was both exciting and difficult. It learned me to see all processes in a different angle, it learned me to control my work from both sides. And I keep learning and being inspired by amazing leaders and mentors.

Looking forward to make a huge bright effort to Game Development Industry as an artist, then as a Leader Artist.
Highlights: - Raised as Leader Artist on my first job as 2D artist. I appreciate it as a big trust from collegues and my own responsibility skills.

- Most of hard skills I gained, I gained from work experience. I easily get along with new workflows and people. And I've often been told that I work with feedback very well and clearly implement all revisions.

- Few times was invited to mentor starter artists. And I'm proud of their results and even more I'm proud that they don't stop and keep the artist's way, no matter how hard it seemed to them on the very start.

She is certified art therapist, current member of EEATA (Association of Art Therapists in Europe). Creator of "Pick your creativity". Generates a new direction of human researching through abstract thinking. Creates tools in the form of games and workshops. Works with children and adults. Throughout my journey, I've become well-versed in using popular software like Maya, 3ds Max, and Blender to breathe life into characters with expressive movements and realistic interactions. My true passion lies in crafting animations that not only captivate the audience but also bring depth and emotion to the storytelling.

Working closely with talented directors, artists, and programmers, I've learned the importance of collaboration and seamless integration of animations into projects. I take pride in my ability to meet tight deadlines without compromising on the quality of my work. It's the thrill of delivering exceptional results within the given timeframes that keeps me motivated.

While my experience has mainly revolved around animated series and games, I'm genuinely excited about the prospect of expanding my skillset to include feature film animation. I believe that my creativity, adaptability, and technical proficiency make me an excellent fit for this new endeavor.

I genuinely look forward to the opportunity to contribute my passion for animation and extensive experience to your team. Let's create something extraordinary together!
